reviewNotes: Pet Campfire is a split-lane asset family. Ember Pup is a character/state asset, not a static prop.
The Ember Pup sheet is RGB with no alpha. The visible checkerboard is baked into the pixels.
Tiny diagnostic cleanup crops suggest conservative keying may work in selected places, but full-sheet cleanup is not approved.
The last column of the Ember Pup sheet contains vertically stacked status/sunrise icons that require careful sourceRect review.
The background source is RGBA but fully opaque and should be treated as a scene-anchor background.
